text:
raj: Heads-up — we need a new GPU nodepool in eu-central3 for a dedicated burst lane. Target workloads: low-latency chat inference, mostly ~2k token sequences. Main constraints: H100 quota in that project is tiny, and our interconnect egress IPs are almost exhausted. Any objections to mixing a10g nodes for baseline and a small H100 canary for tail latencies? @sophia :eyes:

sophia: sounds reasonable. We just need to be explicit about autoscaler limits, taints, and routing. cost-wise a10g looks fine for bulk. H100 should be reserved for pinned models only. What's the expected peak QPS?

nick: ~120 QPS peak, p95 target <150ms. If we send most to a10g and only hot partitions to H100, that should hit cost/latency tradeoff. Need routing policy that can prefer H100 when model version is pinned or request header indicates low-latency SLA.

mia: quick infra check — H100 quota in eu-central3 for our project is currently 2 GPUs. We need at least 4 for this plan (canary + reserve). Also our pool of static egress IPs for interconnect/NAT has 3 free IPs left. Each nodepool and some daemonsets (logging/metrics) will consume ephemeral connections. I'll open a quota ticket for GPUs and request 5 additional NAT IPs.

raj: proposed plan: create two nodepools — "gpu-burst-euc3-a10g" min=0 max=30, and "gpu-burst-euc3-h100-canary" min=0 max=4. Taint H100 nodes with `nvidia.com/gpu=reserved:NoSchedule` and route only tolerant pods there. Autoscaler caps per-az to avoid AZ saturation. Example gcloud snippet (adapt as needed):

```bash
# baseline a10g pool
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-burst-a10g \
  --cluster=redwood-eu-central3 \
  --machine-type=n1-highmem-16 \
  --accelerator type=nvidia-a10g,count=1 \
  --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=30 \
  --node-taints=workload=burst:NoSchedule \
  --labels=infer-tier=burst

# small H100 canary
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-burst-h100 \
  --cluster=redwood-eu-central3 \
  --machine-type=n1-highmem-32 \
  --accelerator type=nvidia-h100,count=1 \
  --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=4 \
  --node-taints=nvidia.com/gpu=reserved:NoSchedule \
  --labels=infer-tier=hot
```

And autoscaler-related annotations to ensure safe eviction behavior:

```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict: "false"
spec:
  minNodes: 0
  maxNodes: 4
```

sophia: two infra notes: 1) consider local-ssd for KV cache on a10g nodes — reduces latency but increases cost + preemptible behavior. 2) We'll need podPriorityClass for hot requests so CA doesn't evict them during scale-down. Also set terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 120 for in-flight requests.

nick: for quota request include: project id, region, exact SKU (H100-1g or cloud-specific name), justification (demo + canary), and expected sustained hours per week. Cloud support typically asks for sustained usage numbers. Mia, can you include those in the ticket?

mia: yes, filing ticket now. Draft justification: "Dedicated demo plus staggered canary traffic for production proof-of-concept; expected peak 120 QPS, ~20% hot path on H100 for first 2 weeks, then ramp to 50% if validated." Also creating a terraform change to reserve 5 NAT IPs and attach to cluster NAT gateway. Will post the PR link shortly.

infra-bot: quota ticket created: #INFR-8231 (H100 quota + 5 NAT IPs) by mia — estimated cloud response 48-72h.

raj: rollout plan: once quotas approved, provision nodepools in staging first, run a 24h soak with synthetic load, then create routing policy to send 5% traffic to H100 pool for 24h, measure p95/cost. If metrics stable, bump to 20% then 50% over a week. If p95 improves and cost per request is acceptable, keep mixed fleet.

sophia: ack. I'll prepare helm values: tolerations, topologySpread for AZ balancing, and CA config. Two followups for infra: 1) reserve ephemeral ports and ensure SNAT port exhaustion won't happen under burst (NAT gateway sizing), 2) confirm cluster autoscaler version supports per-pool max surge settings.

nick: timeline? we need this before next Wed demo.

mia: aiming to get ticket in today, provisioning 48-72h after quota approval. I'll post ticket link + terraform PR once created.

raj: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll add the routing policy and a simple eval harness for p95 tracking. Post updates here.
